Connection pooling and N+1 queries

A connection pool reuses database connections. N+1 occurs when one query loads N records and another
query runs separately for each.

SELECT o.id, c.name, o.total FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id;
Expected result: One query returns order/customer rows instead of one per order.

Interview question: Why limit a connection pool?
Answer: Too many concurrent connections can overwhelm the database.
Remember: Reuse connections; avoid per-row queries.
